suggested_change: Criterion 2 should explicitly define: 'Score regression requires contradictory evidence in new calls, not absence of incremental data. First-call absence of data is not a revision trigger.' Criterion 3 should clarify: 'Partial evidence (1-2 vendors identified, no comprehensive competitive map) = 4/10 minimum. Assign 6/10+ only when 3+ vendors are compared or customer explicitly prioritized one competitor.'
